titulo: A goal you can measure: the M in SMART
lead: Managers have been delegating with SMART for half a century: specific, measurable, achievable, relevant and time-bound. For an agent, the letter that matters most is the M. Without a measure, it can't check its own work and doesn't know when it's finished. "Improve my website" is not a goal. "The home page opens in under two seconds on a phone" is.
objetivo: turn a vague request into a goal with a measure and a deadline that the agent can check on its own.

aprende.t: Check your goal on the page

hero_alt: Desk timer and metal ruler on a clipboard with a blank sheet.

secoes.sub: Tap or click each letter. The middle one is the one that decides.

nos.detalhe: Specific: says exactly what. "The site" is everything; "the home page" is one thing.

Measurable, meaning verifiable: a number, a test, a comparison. It's what lets the agent check its own work and know when to stop. Without the M, it stops when it thinks it's done, not when it's finished.
Achievable with what the agent has: access, tools, permissions. Asking it to change the server without giving it access to the server is not achievable.
Relevant: why this matters now. It's the piece of context that helps the agent decide when a case comes up that you didn't foresee.
Time-bound: by when and how it shows you the result. Without a deadline, the task has no end and no check.

secoes.legenda: The same method managers use with people. With an agent, the M stops being a detail and becomes the stopping criterion.
secoes.dica: Quick test: if you can't say how you'll check it, the agent can't either.

secoes.sub: Three requests rewritten. Tap or click each one.

texto: Measurable: the home page opens in under 2 seconds on a phone, measured three times in a row, by Friday.

exemplo.texto: PageSpeed Insights (pagespeed.web.dev, free), phone profile: three measurements under 2 s.

texto: Vague: "Summarize this new law for the clients."
Measurable: up to 10 lines, cites the law number and the date it takes effect, and says who is affected, today by 6 p.m.

exemplo.texto: Count the lines and find in the text the law number, the date and who is affected.

texto: Vague: "Improve the announcement to the parents."
Measurable: fits on one phone screen, gives the start date in the first sentence, and is approved with no request for corrections, by Friday at 4 p.m.

exemplo.texto: Open it on a phone, find the date in the first sentence, and approve it or not.

secoes.sub: Replace the text between < > with your own.

blocos.conteudo:
Vague request: <your request the way you would have made it before>
Goal: <what, specifically: which page, which task, which document>
Measure: <the number or test that tells you it's done and it came out good>
Deadline: <by when, and how the agent shows you the result>

blocos.rot: Request: the agent asks what's missing

abas.html:
1. The Measure has a number or a test, not an adjective.
  2. The Deadline says by when and how the result gets to you.
  3. You can tell, just by looking at what was delivered, whether it passed or not.

• An adjective instead of a number ("fast", "pretty"): the agent decides on its own what that means.
  • A measure only you can run: prefer a test the agent runs itself.

secoes.titulo: Simulation: a new agent's first day
secoes.sub: A simulated conversation for practice. The agent has just arrived and asks questions. Choose the answer you would give.

personagem.papel: simulation · first day on the team

abre.cliente: Hi! I've been assigned to take care of the store's website. What would you like me to do?

opcoes.comenta: With no measure, the agent will change whatever it sees fit and stop whenever it sees fit. You won't be able to tell whether it got better.
It's specific (the home page), but "faster" still has no number. The agent will have to ask.

opcoes.t: Make the home page open in under 2 seconds on a phone.
opcoes.comenta: Specific, with a number. The agent already knows the target; you still need to agree on how to measure it.

medida.cliente: Got it. And how do I check that I got there?

opcoes.t: You'll feel it when it's fast.
opcoes.comenta: "Feel" is not a measure. The agent has no way to check itself, and you have no way to approve.

opcoes.t: Measure on PageSpeed Insights, mobile profile: done when it comes in under 2 s on three measurements in a row.
opcoes.comenta: That's the M: a test the agent runs itself. Three measurements rule out a lucky result.

opcoes.t: Show me the before and after.
opcoes.comenta: It helps you approve, but the agent still doesn't know when to stop. Give the number that ends the task.

fronteira.cliente: To save time, can I swap the photos and change the layout?

opcoes.t: You can compress the photos. Layout, text and prices don't change without asking me.
opcoes.comenta: A clear boundary: what's allowed and what needs your yes. The agent works freely inside it.

opcoes.t: You can change everything, as long as it gets fast.
opcoes.comenta: A measure with no boundary: the fastest way may be to cut half the page. It hits the number and breaks the store.

opcoes.t: Do whatever you think is best and tell me afterward.
opcoes.comenta: Trust is good, but "tell me afterward" finds the problem late. Say up front what needs your yes.

prazo.cliente: Agreed. By when, and how do I show you?

opcoes.comenta: With no deadline, the task has no end and no scheduled check.
There's a deadline, but it doesn't say how you'll receive the result. You'll have to ask on Friday.

opcoes.t: By Friday. Send me the three measurements and the list of what changed.
opcoes.comenta: Deadline and delivery format. On Friday you check it in two minutes.

fim-vago.texto: With no way to measure, the agent keeps working until it thinks it's good enough. Go back and give it a number or a test it can run itself.

fim-fronteira.titulo: Hit the target, broke the store
fim-fronteira.texto: The page got fast because it lost the photos and half the text. A measure with no boundary is dangerous: say what can't change without your yes.

fim-prazo.texto: The goal was good, but with no deadline or delivery format nobody knows when to check. Always close with by when and how to show it.

fim-bom.texto: Ready to work, as long as the measure has a number: target, test, boundary and deadline. If at any step you stayed with "faster" or "show me", the scoreboard shows what was missing: go back and give the number.

fim-quase.texto: The agent knows the target, the measure, the boundary and the deadline. It just doesn't know how to deliver: on Friday you'll have to ask for the measurements. Say the delivery format too.

fim-tarde.texto: The agent changed the layout and touched the prices to gain speed. You only found out afterward, with the page already live. Say up front what needs your yes.

secoes.licao: The agent asks what you forgot to say: the number, the test, the boundary and the deadline. Put it in the sheet up front, and it won't need to ask.

secoes.ok: OK: goal with all {n} fields filled in
secoes.exemplo:
Vague request: improve my website.
Goal: cut the load time of the store's home page on a phone.
Measure: under 2 seconds in three tests in a row, phone profile.
Deadline: by Friday, with the three test results and a list of what changed.
secoes.exemplo_errado:
Vague request: improve my website.
Goal: make the store's website better.
Measure: looks good, no complaints.
Deadline: one of these days, no rush.

secoes.sub: Go back to the sheet from lesson 4 and strengthen the Measure field.

exercicios.texto: Take three vague requests from your diagnosis (lesson 1) and rewrite each one using SMART.
exercicios.pronto: all three have a number or a test where an adjective used to be.

exercicios.texto: Write your agent's goal.txt and paste it into the checker above.
exercicios.pronto: the checker answers "OK: goal with all 4 fields filled in" and you wrote, in one sentence, how you check the Measure by looking at a delivery.

exercicios.texto: Hand over the goal and ask it to tell you, when it finishes, how it checked each item of the Measure. If the measure calls for a tool it can't access (in a chat, PageSpeed, for example), you're the one who measures, using the same test.
exercicios.pronto: the delivery came with a check of each item, and you redid one of the tests and got the same result.

secoes.sub: How to delegate to AI: the SMART goal.
The explanation appears after your answer.

perguntas.p: Why is the M the letter that weighs the most for an agent?
opcoes: Because it makes the request shorter.
Because with a measure, the agent checks its own work and knows when it's done.
Because it's the first letter to be read.
perguntas.explica: Without a measure, it stops when it thinks it looks good. With a number or a test, it checks for itself and you approve without redoing the measurement.

perguntas.p: Which of these is a measurable goal?
opcoes: Make the spreadsheet more professional, with colors, charts and totals on every tab.
One tab per month, total equal to the bank statement, by the 5th.
Improve the spreadsheet as much as possible.
perguntas.explica: It has the what (one tab per month), the test (total equal to the bank statement) and the deadline (the 5th). The others depend on the opinion of whoever is looking.

perguntas.p: In the simulation, "you can change everything, as long as it's fast" went wrong. Why?
opcoes: Because a measure without a boundary lets the agent hit the number by breaking everything else.
Because the agent doesn't know how to work with layouts.
Because the store's name and the website address were missing, so the agent didn't know where to work.
perguntas.explica: The fastest way might be to remove photos and text. Along with the measure goes the boundary: what doesn't change without your yes.

itens.texto: Specific, measurable, achievable, relevant and time-bound: the same method you'd use to delegate to people.
A number or test the agent can run on its own is the stopping criterion.
Also say what can't change to hit the target.
